title: BlightMist Idle
summary: Every drop feeds something. Ore becomes ingots becomes gear becomes power. Monster parts become permanent power. Seven classes, six life skills (just in Act 1 alone), talent trees,  card collection, and much more — all compounding, while you're on and offline.
about:
The line has to hold.

Nobody is winning this war. The recruiters won't tell you that, but Kingro will. The Blightmist took most of the world a long time ago, and what's left is held by people who go out every day knowing the best possible outcome is that nothing gets worse.

You're one of them now.

Progress that doesn't stop when you do. Fight, gather, craft and level through fourteen zones of Act 1 and beyond. Close the game and your character keeps working — come back to the spoils of hours you didn't have to sit through.

Seven Tier 1 classes, seven stories. Start as a Novice and become a Footman, Scout, Cleric, Monk, Elementalist, Adventurer, or stay a Novice and walk a broader road. Your class isn't a stat block — the people you meet knew someone who made the same choice, and they'll tell you what happened to them.

Your choices are remembered. Every answer you give is recorded. Be decent and the world warms to you. Be ruthless and people start losing patience — though you may find you've made friends elsewhere. The story is told either way. The tone is entirely up to you.

A world worth digging into. Mining, herbalism, woodcutting and more. Smelt raw ore into something worth carrying. Feed monster parts to the Monster Den for permanent power. Collect cards from everything you kill. Build a talent tree that's actually yours.


Windows, Steam, are the current target with mobile/mac later; one account with every character working together to bolster your progression.

"The goal was never to win. Hold the line." - Kingro


Guild System   
Create guilds and challenge rotating weekly bosses for premium currency rewards and rankings. Individual performance and the overall guilds performance both contribute to the weekly premium currency Jade payout. Just by participating you get a weekly payout! 
 
Card Catalog 
Grind monster and obtain their cards. Collect more cards to get a higher tier bonus for you entire account.   
        
Act Expansions     
Each act includes a minimum of 2 new mechanics, 3 new life gather skills which in turn feed into new or already existing mechanics like crafting.     
    


Class Customization      
Dive in and progress to start unlocking major build defining items to mix with the classes talents. Want to convert your physical damage to elemental and be a magic warrior? You can, give the right equipment. Want to be an auto-attacking physical mage? Sure why not, there's no limits to the different customizations you can do. With 3 different weapon types per class, this further increases the build you want to make whether is fast hitting elemental attacks, or slow hard hitting crits.       
      
Cash Shop      
Cosmetics and no P2W. There is not a single item in the cash shop that gives stats. The cash shop Supporter Packages do include an account wide title- which you already unlock the same effect of when you make your first character; and cash shop titles do not stack what so ever; hence the pure "Supporter Package" verbiage.      
      
Road Map + Much more that wont fit in this window!      
Join the discord to start interacting and finding out more information on BlightMist. I am pouring everything I have into this game and I am so excited to share this and take the next steps forward.
